zh-TW: 蒐證
en: Evidence Search
note: trigger: 進入事務所場景（引導） | guided (locks other input)

zh-TW: 現場的每個角落都可能藏著線索。移動游標，靠近時會發光的地方就是調查點，點一下就能調查。調查點有五種：檢視、證物、證詞、機關與鎖定區域。
en: Clues can hide in every corner of a scene. Move the cursor; anything that glows as you approach is an Investigation Point, and one click investigates it. There are five types: Examine, Evidence, Testimony, Mechanism, and Locked Area.

zh-TW: 證物卡
en: Evidence Cards
note: trigger: 首次取得證物

zh-TW: 調查得到的東西會變成證物卡，收進證物冊。卡上有五種屬性標籤：時間、地點、人物、物理特性、醜聞。之後推理時，系統就是靠這些標籤判斷證物之間接不接得上。
en: What you find becomes an Evidence Card and goes into your Evidence Book. Each card carries five kinds of Tag: Time, Place, Person, Physical, and Scandal. When you reason later, the game uses these Tags to decide whether two pieces of evidence fit together.

zh-TW: 證詞卡
en: Testimony Cards
note: trigger: 首次取得證詞

zh-TW: 與人交談也能取得線索。證詞卡和證物卡一樣可以拿來推理，而且一定帶有【人物】標籤。同一個人每案最多問兩次，要問什麼請想清楚。
en: Talking to people can turn up clues too. A Testimony Card can be used in reasoning just like an Evidence Card, and it always carries a 【Person】 Tag. You can question the same person at most twice per case, so think carefully about what to ask.

zh-TW: 懷錶刻度
en: Pocket-Watch Ticks
note: trigger: 首次調查第 3 個調查點

zh-TW: 左上的懷錶是蒐證的時間。從下一章起，每次調查新的地方都會花掉一格刻度，刻度用完就得離開現場。這一章是在自己家裡，時間不限，可以慢慢看。
en: The pocket watch at the upper left is your Evidence Search clock. From the next chapter on, every new place you investigate costs one Tick, and when the Ticks run out, you must leave the scene. This chapter takes place in your own home, so time is unlimited. Take your time.

zh-TW: 結束蒐證
en: End Search
note: trigger: 取得全部必需證物後

zh-TW: 覺得看夠了，就按「結束蒐證」。結束後不能再回到現場，而你漏掉的線索，往往會落到對手手裡。
en: When you feel you've seen enough, press "End Search". Once you do, you can't go back to the scene, and the clues you missed often end up in your opponent's hands.

zh-TW: 線索板
en: Clue Board
note: trigger: 首次進入線索板（引導） | guided (locks other input)

zh-TW: 這裡是整理推理的地方。從左邊的抽屜把證物卡拖到板上。板上最多可以放 15 張卡。
en: This is where you organise your reasoning. Drag Evidence Cards from the drawer on the left onto the board. The board holds up to 15 cards.

zh-TW: 歸類理由
en: Rationale
note: trigger: 首次把卡放上板面（引導） | guided (locks other input)

zh-TW: 每件證物都要寫下「它能證明什麼」。從右邊三個理由中選一個。三個都說得通，但只有一個與真相相符。沒選理由的卡不能連結。
en: For each piece of evidence, write down "what it proves". Choose one of the three Rationales on the right. All three sound plausible, but only one matches the truth. A card with no Rationale can't be linked.

zh-TW: 拉線
en: Drawing Links
note: trigger: 兩張卡都選好理由後（引導） | guided (locks other input)

zh-TW: 從卡片右緣的黃銅接口拖到另一張卡，就能把兩件證物連起來。共享相同標籤、而且理由都正確的兩張卡會接成一條實線，這叫「實證連結」。
en: Drag from the brass socket on a card's right edge to another card to link the two pieces of evidence. Two cards that share a Tag and both have correct Rationales are joined by a solid line. This is called a Solid Link.

zh-TW: 虛線與彈回
en: Dashed Lines and Bounce-Backs
note: trigger: 首次出現虛線或無效連結

zh-TW: 如果兩張卡共享標籤、但有一張的理由不對，或只靠一個表面上的「擦邊」標籤相接，線會變成虛線，這叫「詭辯連結」；沒有共同標籤的卡則連不起來，線會直接彈回。虛線的意義，之後的大案子會再說明。
en: If two cards share a Tag but one has the wrong Rationale, or they connect only through a tangential Tag, the line becomes dashed. This is called a Sophistry Link. Cards with no Tag in common can't be linked, and the line simply springs back. What dashed lines mean will be explained in a later, bigger case.

zh-TW: 推理鏈
en: Reasoning Chains
note: trigger: 首次組成 2 張以上的鏈

zh-TW: 用連結串成一直線的卡，就是一條推理鏈，2 到 5 張，不能分岔。板上最多 3 條。論戰時你出示的武器，就是這些推理鏈。
en: Cards strung together by links in a straight line form a Reasoning Chain: 2 to 5 cards, no branching. The board holds at most 3 chains. In a Debate, the weapons you present are these chains.

zh-TW: 同時出招
en: Simultaneous Moves
note: trigger: 布丁論戰開始（引導） | guided (locks other input)

zh-TW: 論戰的每一回合，你和對手會同時決定要做什麼，再一起翻牌。你看不到他選了什麼，但他會露出「預兆」：一句話、一個小動作，和一個亮起的主張。這場不扣主導權，3 回合內指出亞瑟的 2 個矛盾就贏了。
en: Each round of a Debate, you and your opponent decide on your moves at the same time, then reveal together. You can't see what they chose, but they give off a "Tell": a line, a small gesture, and a lit claim. In this debate Dominance isn't deducted; you win by pointing out Arthur's 2 contradictions within 3 rounds.

zh-TW: 讀預兆
en: Reading the Tell
note: trigger: 第 1 回合，預兆出現時（引導） | guided (locks other input)

zh-TW: 亞瑟挺起胸膛、雙手叉腰，說他一覺睡到天亮——他要「開口主張」了。右邊的眼睛圖示全睜開，代表這是「明示」：他一定會照這個預兆出手。
en: Arthur puffs out his chest and puts his hands on his hips, claiming he slept straight through until morning. He's about to Assert. The eye icon on the right is wide open, which means the Tell is "Clear": he will definitely make the move it shows.

zh-TW: 他要開口就守
en: When He Speaks, Defend
note: trigger: 第 1 回合選行動時（引導） | guided (locks other input)

zh-TW: 對手要開口時，選「反駁」：對準亮起的主張，備好能推翻它的證物，等他說到一半時截斷。選好證物後按「鎖定」。
en: When the opponent is about to speak up, choose "Rebut": aim at the lit claim, have evidence ready that can overturn it, and cut in halfway through his sentence. After choosing your evidence, press "Lock In".

zh-TW: 截斷
en: Cut-In
note: trigger: 第 1 回合截斷成功後

zh-TW: 截斷成功時你不會受傷，被反駁的主張會被推翻。但反駁只能接住「開口」：對手如果在防守，反駁就會落空。
en: When a Cut-In lands, you take no damage and the targeted claim is overturned. But Rebut can only catch an Assert: if the opponent is defending, your Rebut whiffs.

zh-TW: 他要護短就攻
en: When He Covers Up, Attack
note: trigger: 第 2 回合，預兆出現時（引導） | guided (locks other input)

zh-TW: 亞瑟把袖子往下拉，想遮住袖口——他要「補強」說法了。對手在防守時，就是出手的時候。選「實證連鎖」，出示一段只有實線的推理鏈。
en: Arthur tugs his sleeve down to hide his cuff: he's about to Reinforce his story. When the opponent is defending, that's your moment to strike. Choose "Solid Chain" and present a chain containing only solid lines.

zh-TW: 攻與守
en: Attack and Defence
note: trigger: 第 2 回合結算後

zh-TW: 攻擊有兩種：實證連鎖與詭辯；防守也有兩種：反駁與觀察。哪一招對上哪一招會怎樣，都寫在右邊的「對決表」裡，論戰中隨時可以打開來看。
en: There are two kinds of attack, Solid Chain and Sophistry, and two kinds of defence, Rebut and Observe. What happens when one meets another is all written in the "Matchup Table" on the right, which you can open at any time during a Debate.

zh-TW: 動搖與論破
en: Shaken and Break
note: trigger: 亞瑟第一次動搖

zh-TW: 亞瑟慌了，這是「動搖」。動搖的下一回合，用能直指真相的證物出手，就能「論破」他。他又要開口了：用反駁對準最後一個主張，出示袖口。
en: Arthur is flustered. This is "Shaken". On the round after he's Shaken, strike with evidence that points straight at the truth and you can "Break" him. He's about to speak again: Rebut, aimed at his last claim, presenting the cuff.

zh-TW: 對手筆記
en: Opponent Notes
note: trigger: 布丁論戰結束後

zh-TW: 亞瑟把你看到的小動作和對手的習慣都記在「對手筆記」裡。下次遇到同一個人，先翻一翻。
en: Arthur records the gestures you've seen and the opponent's habits in the "Opponent Notes". Next time you face the same person, give them a read first.

zh-TW: 新搭檔
en: A New Partner
note: trigger: Ch.1 結算

zh-TW: 亞瑟正式成為你的助手。從下一章起，他能鑑定醫療與機械類證物，並在論戰中替你擋下一次陷阱。
en: Arthur is now officially your assistant. From the next chapter on, he can appraise medical and mechanical evidence, and will block one trap for you during a Debate.

zh-TW: 刻度有限
en: Limited Ticks
note: trigger: 進入鐘錶店場景

zh-TW: 從這一章開始，調查新的地方要花懷錶刻度。每個現場大約只看得完七成，哪裡值得花時間，由你決定。
en: From this chapter on, investigating a new spot costs pocket-watch Ticks. You'll only get through about seventy per cent of any scene, so it's up to you to decide where your time is best spent.

zh-TW: 鑑定
en: Appraisal
note: trigger: 首次取得帶「？」的證物（引導） | guided (locks other input)

zh-TW: 卡上的「？」代表這個標籤還看不出來。選中卡片，按「交給亞瑟」，他會用醫療或機械知識替你鑑定。鑑定不花刻度，但每案次數有限。未鑑定的標籤不能用來連結。
en: A "?" on a card means that Tag can't be made out yet. Select the card and press "Hand to Arthur", and he'll appraise it with his medical or mechanical knowledge. Appraisals cost no Ticks, but the number per case is limited. Unappraised Tags can't be used for linking.

zh-TW: 漏掉的證物
en: Missed Evidence
note: trigger: 結束蒐證，有漏證時

zh-TW: 你沒撿到的證物，有些會落到對手手中。它們會讓對手的說法更難推翻。畫面只會告訴你漏了幾件，不會說是哪幾件。
en: Some of the evidence you didn't pick up will fall into your opponent's hands, making their story harder to overturn. The screen will only tell you how many pieces you missed, not which ones.

zh-TW: 論戰與主導權
en: Debate and Dominance
note: trigger: 首次進入正式論戰（引導） | guided (locks other input)

zh-TW: 論戰比的是誰的推理更自洽。左下與右上的蒸汽壓力錶是雙方的「主導權」。把對手的主導權打到零，你就贏了；你的歸零，就輸了。
en: A Debate is a contest of whose reasoning is more self-consistent. The steam pressure gauges at the lower left and upper right are each side's "Dominance". Drive your opponent's to zero and you win; if yours hits zero, you lose.

zh-TW: 主張鏈
en: The Claim Chain
note: trigger: 論戰第 1 回合，預兆出現時

zh-TW: 上方一排是對手的主張，亮起的那一個，就是他這回合要推的說法。他開口主張時，傷害是一個基礎值，再加上場上每個主張 4 點；推翻的主張越多，他說話就越沒分量。
en: The row of claims along the top belongs to your opponent, and the lit one is the claim he'll push this round. When he Asserts, the damage is a base value plus 4 for every claim on the table; the more claims you've overturned, the less weight his words carry.

zh-TW: 反駁截斷
en: Rebut and Cut-In
note: trigger: 首次截斷對手的主張（引導） | guided (locks other input)

zh-TW: 截斷成功：你不受傷，那個主張被推翻，對手還被你反咬一口，受到 30 點傷害。反駁一定要有能推翻亮起主張的證物；手上沒有的話，反駁按鈕會變灰，這時只能用觀察減傷。
en: On a successful Cut-In you take no damage, the claim is overturned, and you bite back for 30 damage. A Rebut needs evidence that can overturn the lit claim; if you have none, the Rebut button is greyed out, and all you can do is Observe to reduce the damage.

zh-TW: 空過
en: Whiff
note: trigger: 首次反駁落空

zh-TW: 對手這回合在防守，你的反駁沒有東西可接。他的補強成功了，主張回到場上，而且沒被打中的補強還會讓他回復一些主導權。
en: The opponent was defending this round, so your Rebut had nothing to catch. Their Reinforce succeeded, the claim returned to the table, and a Reinforce that isn't hit also restores some of their Dominance.

zh-TW: 實證連鎖
en: Solid Chain
note: trigger: 首次選實證連鎖（引導） | guided (locks other input)

zh-TW: 只含實線的鏈段用「實證連鎖」出示。基礎傷害是 14，每多接一條實證連結，倍率就加 0.5。如果出示的證物正好推翻目標主張，主張會被粉碎。對手補強時，傷害會減半。
en: A chain segment containing only solid lines is presented as a "Solid Chain". Base damage is 14, and each additional Solid Link adds 0.5 to the multiplier. If the evidence you present happens to overturn the target claim, the claim is smashed. Against a Reinforce, damage is halved.

zh-TW: 交鋒
en: Clash
note: trigger: 首次交鋒

zh-TW: 你出手時對手也出手了：雙方各中一擊，而且在交鋒中，你的推理鏈只打得出一半的傷害。對手要開口的時候，反駁通常比搶攻划算。
en: You struck just as your opponent struck: both sides take a hit, and in a Clash your chain deals only half its damage. When the opponent is about to speak, Rebut is usually better value than rushing in.

zh-TW: 模糊預兆
en: Vague Tells
note: trigger: 首次出現模糊預兆

zh-TW: 半睜的眼睛代表「模糊」：下面兩個行動，一個是真的，一個是誘餌。先看兩個選項是不是同一類——如果兩個都是攻擊，選防守就不會錯。
en: A half-open eye means "Vague": of the two moves listed below, one is real and one is a decoy. First check whether the two options are the same type. If both are attacks, defending is never wrong.

zh-TW: 行為規則
en: Behaviour Rules
note: trigger: 首次出現 ★ 標記

zh-TW: 有星號的那一個比較可能是真的：對手有些習慣，例如「說法被推翻後傾向補強」。這些習慣叫「行為規則」，亞瑟每看到一條就記進對手筆記。星號只是「比較可能」，不是保證。
en: The option with a star is more likely to be the real one: opponents have habits, such as "tends to Reinforce after a claim is overturned". These habits are called "Behaviour Rules", and Arthur records each one in the Opponent Notes as soon as he sees it. A star only means "likelier", not a guarantee.

zh-TW: 狐耳直覺
en: Fox-Ear Instinct
note: trigger: 首次出現模糊預兆後的第一次選行動

zh-TW: 拿不定主意時，可以用「狐耳直覺」：模糊的預兆會拿掉誘餌，只剩真正的那一個。每場論戰只有兩次，用在關鍵的回合。
en: When you can't decide, use "Fox-Ear Instinct": a Vague Tell loses its decoy and leaves only the real move. You get just two per debate, so save them for the key rounds.

zh-TW: 粉碎主張
en: Smashing Claims
note: trigger: 首次成功粉碎主張

zh-TW: 被推翻的主張會消失，但對手每回合重新陳述時會補回一個說法。補進來的說法如果來自你漏掉的證物，角落會標出來。
en: An overturned claim disappears, but each round the opponent restates their case and adds a claim back. If the added claim comes from evidence you missed, it's marked in the corner.

zh-TW: 勝負之後
en: After the Verdict
note: trigger: Ch.2 結算

zh-TW: 輸掉論戰不會結束遊戲，但下一個案子會從比較差的位置開始。只有最後一戰的結果，才會直接決定結局。
en: Losing a Debate doesn't end the game, but the next case starts from a worse position. Only the result of the final battle decides the ending directly.

zh-TW: 報紙
en: The Newspaper
note: trigger: 首次轉場報紙

zh-TW: 每個案子結束後，報紙會刊出「世人眼中的結果」——不一定是真相。你看過的報紙都會收進剪報簿。
en: After each case, the paper prints "the result as the world sees it", which isn't always the truth. Every issue you read goes into your Scrapbook.

zh-TW: 勢如破竹
en: Unstoppable
note: trigger: 首次疊上破竹

zh-TW: 你讀對了他的出手。每次做出有利的應對——他開口時截斷、他補強時靜靜觀察、他布陷阱時用實證或觀察，或用醜聞證物讓他動搖——左下就疊一層「破竹」，最多三層。每一層讓推理鏈傷害和截斷的反擊各提高一成；疊滿三層時，論破還能少用一張證物。但只要應對錯一手，氣勢就會斷掉，從頭再來。實證撞補強仍能削減，但不算讀對；想疊破竹，對補強要用觀察（之後學會詭辯也可以）。
en: You read their move correctly. Every time you make a favourable response (cutting in when they Assert, quietly Observing when they Reinforce, answering a trap with solid evidence or Observe, or Shaking them with Scandal evidence), a layer of "Unstoppable" stacks up at the lower left, up to three. Each layer raises chain damage and Cut-In counters by ten per cent; at three layers, a Break needs one fewer piece of evidence. But one wrong response breaks your momentum, and you start over. A Solid Chain against a Reinforce still chips them down, but it doesn't count as a correct read; to stack Unstoppable against a Reinforce, use Observe (or Sophistry, once you've learned it).

zh-TW: 警督信任度
en: Inspector's Trust
note: trigger: 巴斯克維爾警督登場後

zh-TW: 右上的警徽是巴斯克維爾警督對你的信任，共五枚。信任越高，他提供的驗屍報告、證人名單與現場權限越多；論戰輸了，或手段太難看，信任就會下降。
en: The badges at the upper right show how much Inspector Baskerville trusts you: five in all. The higher his trust, the more post-mortem reports, witness lists and scene access he provides; lose a debate, or use underhanded methods, and his trust drops.

zh-TW: 熱身小論戰
en: Warm-up Debate
note: trigger: 首次熱身小論戰（引導） | guided (locks other input)

zh-TW: 警督已經自信地抓了一個人。在正式調查之前，先糾正他的誤判：他開口時，用反駁出示一件能推翻他的證物。熱身不扣主導權；一次就說對，他會多給你一些情報；連錯三次，他就不耐煩了。
en: The Inspector has already confidently arrested someone. Before the real investigation, correct his misjudgement: when he speaks, use Rebut to present a piece of evidence that overturns him. Warm-ups don't cost Dominance; get it right in one go and he'll give you extra intelligence; get it wrong three times and he loses patience.

zh-TW: 現場權限
en: Scene Access
note: trigger: 首次遇到需許可的區域

zh-TW: 黃色封條的區域需要許可。在警方參與的案子裡，警督的信任夠高就會讓你進去；信任不足時，就得想別的辦法。
en: Areas with yellow tape need a permit. In cases where the police are involved, the Inspector will let you in if his trust is high enough; if it isn't, you'll have to find another way.

zh-TW: 猛攻
en: Onslaught
note: trigger: 首次出現猛攻預兆

zh-TW: 對手扯鬆領巾、往前踏了一步——這是「猛攻」。猛攻的傷害是一般主張的 1.25 倍。但這也是機會：在他猛攻時用反駁截斷，他會當場亂了陣腳。
en: The opponent loosens his cravat and steps forward: this is an "Onslaught". An Onslaught does 1.25 times the damage of an ordinary Assert. But it is also an opening: Cut In on an Onslaught with Rebut and they lose their footing on the spot.

zh-TW: 動搖
en: Shaken
note: trigger: 首次截斷猛攻

zh-TW: 對手的壓力錶開始洩氣了，這是「動搖」：下一回合，對手受到的攻擊變成 1.5 倍，而且論破只能在那一回合打出。截斷猛攻、用醜聞類證物戳中痛處，或一次出示 4 張以上的實證連鎖，都能讓對手動搖。
en: The opponent's pressure gauge starts to leak: they are "Shaken". For the next round, the opponent takes 1.5 times damage from attacks, and a Break can only be played in that one round. Cutting in on an Onslaught, striking a sore spot with Scandal evidence, or presenting a Solid Chain of 4 or more cards can all leave an opponent Shaken.

zh-TW: 論破
en: Break
note: trigger: 對手動搖的下一回合，選行動時（引導） | guided (locks other input)

zh-TW: 現在是論破的時機。出示一件指向唯一事實的強攻證物，或一段 2 張以上的實證連鎖，就能「論破」對手，直接削去他七成的主導權。用實證連鎖論破時，補強擋不住、陷阱也抓不到你；用反駁論破時，只有對手剛好開口才會成立。
en: Now is the time to Break. Present a Striker evidence that points to a single fact, or a Solid Chain of 2 or more cards, and you can "Break" the opponent, stripping away seventy per cent of their Dominance outright. When you Break with a Solid Chain, Reinforce can't stop it and traps can't catch you; when you Break with Rebut, it only works if the opponent happens to speak up.

zh-TW: 時機錯過
en: Missed Window
note: trigger: 首次反駁論破落空

zh-TW: 對手在防守，你的反駁論破落空了，動搖也跟著結束。下一次動搖時，如果看不出他要攻還是守，用實證連鎖比較穩。
en: The opponent was defending, so your Rebut-Break whiffed, and the Shaken state ended with it. Next time they're Shaken, if you can't tell whether they'll attack or defend, a Solid Chain is the safer bet.

zh-TW: 尾聲階段
en: Endgame
note: trigger: 首次進入尾聲

zh-TW: 被論破的對手不會乖乖認輸，他會使出最後的反撲。反撲的類型一定是明示，但要出對的牌才擋得住。尾聲只有一回合：答錯了，你會受到 30 點傷害，論破也會失效。
en: A Broken opponent won't concede quietly; they will launch one last counterattack. The counterattack type is always Clear, but you must play the right card to stop it. The Endgame lasts only one round: answer wrongly and you take 30 damage, and the Break is voided.

zh-TW: 收尾：犯人
en: Finishing Up: Culprit
note: trigger: 犯人型對手的尾聲開始時

zh-TW: 走投無路的犯人會開始胡亂栽贓。等他開口，用反駁截斷，出示一段 2 張以上、沒有弱點的實證連鎖，穩穩地結束它。不要觀察，也不要再用詭辯。
en: A cornered culprit starts flinging blame around wildly. Wait for him to speak, cut in with Rebut, and present a Solid Chain of 2 or more cards with no Weak Points to finish it for good. Don't Observe, and don't use Sophistry again.

zh-TW: 被逼急了
en: Pushed Too Far
note: trigger: 首次觸發行為規則 3

zh-TW: 對手的主導權第一次掉到一半以下時，一定會猛攻，而且預兆是明示。記住這條規則：它是截斷猛攻、讓對手動搖的好機會。
en: The first time the opponent's Dominance drops to half or below, he will always go on the Onslaught, and the Tell will be Clear. Remember this rule: it's a perfect chance to cut in on his Onslaught and leave him Shaken.

zh-TW: 黃金線索
en: Golden Clue
note: trigger: G-01 首次出現在線索板上

zh-TW: 上一個案子裡，你正確推理出的關鍵證物，已經默默收進檔案，現在成了「黃金線索」。它指向唯一的事實，攻擊力最強。黃金線索不會因為使用而消失。
en: The key evidence you reasoned out correctly in the previous case has quietly been filed away, and is now a "Golden Clue". It points to a single fact and has the greatest attack power. A Golden Clue is not used up when you use it.

zh-TW: 失守
en: Breached
note: trigger: 首次失守（不限章節，以第一次真正觸發為準；推薦路線約在 Ch.6）

zh-TW: 你正面吃下了他的猛攻，陣地失守了。下一回合不能反駁，只能攻擊或觀察，破竹也歸零了。看到猛攻的預兆時，用反駁截斷它，才不會失守。詭辯被陷阱抓到、援護又沒擋下時，也會失守。
en: You took his Onslaught head-on, and your position is breached. Next round you can't Rebut, only attack or Observe, and Unstoppable resets to zero. When you see the Tell of an Onslaught, cut in on it with Rebut to avoid being breached. You are also breached when a Sophistry is caught in a trap and Cover doesn't block it.

zh-TW: 困獸之鬥
en: Cornered
note: trigger: 首次觸發困獸（不限章節，以第一次真正觸發為準；推薦路線約在 Ch.5）

zh-TW: 對手被逼成了困獸：被你截斷第二次，或主導權掉到三成以下時就會這樣。接下來兩回合，他的攻擊更重，也不能補強——但他急了，預兆會清楚一級。這是危險，也是機會。
en: The opponent has been driven into a corner: that happens when you cut in on them a second time, or when their Dominance falls below thirty per cent. For the next two rounds they hit harder and can't Reinforce, but in their desperation their Tell is one level clearer. This is both a danger and an opportunity.

zh-TW: 對手偵探
en: Rival Detective
note: trigger: 維多封鎖現場時

zh-TW: 對手偵探維多・克勞已經封鎖了部分現場。蒐證時間比平常少；你漏掉的證物，他會撿走，而且會在論戰中拿來對付你。
en: The rival detective, Victor Crowe, has already sealed off part of the scene. You have less time to search than usual; any evidence you miss, he will pick up and use against you in the Debate.

zh-TW: 詭辯連結
en: Sophistry Links
note: trigger: 首次在線索板建立詭辯連結

zh-TW: 虛線是「詭辯連結」：兩張卡共享標籤，但其中一張的理由不正確，或只靠表面的「擦邊」標籤相接。詭辯的倍率是 0.8，比實證的 0.5 更高，但每條詭辯都會在鏈上留下一個弱點。
en: A dashed line is a "Sophistry Link": the two cards share a Tag, but one of them has an incorrect Rationale, or they connect only through a tangential Tag. Sophistry has a multiplier of 0.8, higher than Solid's 0.5, but every Sophistry Link leaves a Weak Point on the chain.

zh-TW: 詭辯
en: Sophistry
note: trigger: 首次論戰中，選中含詭辯的鏈段

zh-TW: 含虛線的鏈段要用「詭辯」出示。對手補強時，詭辯能全額打穿他的防守，這是實證做不到的。你也可以在這時臨場硬接一條新的虛線，但它同樣會留下弱點。
en: A chain segment containing a dashed line must be presented as "Sophistry". When the opponent Reinforces, Sophistry punches through their defence at full damage, which a Solid Chain can't do. You can also improvise a new dashed link on the spot, but it too leaves a Weak Point.

zh-TW: 設陷
en: Set a Trap
note: trigger: 首次出現設陷預兆

zh-TW: 維多推了一下單片眼鏡——這是「設陷」。陷阱專抓詭辯：你這時出詭辯，傷害作廢，還會受到 25 點暴擊，那條虛線下一回合也會斷開。但陷阱對實證沒用：用實證連鎖出手，傷害全額打進去，他下一回合還不能補強。
en: Victor pushes up his monocle: this is "Set a Trap". Traps catch Sophistry: if you use Sophistry then, your damage is voided, you take a 25-point crit, and that dashed line snaps next round. But traps do nothing against solid evidence: attack with a Solid Chain and you deal full damage, and he can't Reinforce next round.

zh-TW: 援護
en: Cover
note: trigger: 首次在援護可用時選詭辯（引導） | guided (locks other input)

zh-TW: 覺得他要設陷、又非出詭辯不可時，可以先按「援護」再鎖定：這一回合若被陷阱抓到，亞瑟會替你擋下暴擊，虛線不會斷開，惡名也不會增加。但援護每場只有一次，鎖定就會用掉，就算他沒設陷也一樣——這是一次預測。
en: If you think he's about to Set a Trap but you have to use Sophistry anyway, press "Cover" before locking in: if the trap catches you this round, Arthur blocks the crit for you, the dashed line stays intact, and your Notoriety doesn't rise. But Cover can be used only once per debate, and it's spent the moment you lock in, even if he doesn't set a trap. It's a prediction.

zh-TW: 拆穿陷阱
en: Exposing the Trap
note: trigger: 首次觀察拆穿陷阱

zh-TW: 你沒出牌，靜靜看著他把陷阱擺好——現在大家都看見了。對手多了一個脆弱的主張，下一回合他一定會出攻擊。
en: You played no card and quietly watched him set the trap, and now everyone can see it. The opponent gains a Fragile claim, and next round they will definitely attack.

zh-TW: 名聲
en: Reputation
note: trigger: 首次詭辯被拆穿

zh-TW: 被拆穿的詭辯不只會痛一次。報紙在看，警督也在看——手段太難看，明天的頭條不會好聽。
en: An exposed Sophistry hurts more than once. The papers are watching, and so is the Inspector; if your methods look ugly enough, tomorrow's headline won't be kind.

zh-TW: 漏掉的證物
en: Missed Evidence
note: trigger: 首次出現來自漏證的主張

zh-TW: 角落寫著「來自：你漏掉的證物」的主張，是對手用你沒撿到的東西拼出來的。它和一般主張一樣打得碎，但它在提醒你：現場還有你沒看見的東西。
en: A claim marked "From: evidence you missed" in the corner was put together by the opponent from things you didn't pick up. It can be smashed like any other claim, but it's a reminder that there are things at the scene you haven't seen.

zh-TW: 鏡像
en: Mirror
note: trigger: 維多第一次照鏡像出招後

zh-TW: 維多會預判你重複上一回合的行動，先出它的剋招：你剛出過詭辯，他就設陷；你剛反駁，他就補強。對付這種對手，換招就是反制。
en: Victor predicts that you'll repeat your last round's action and plays its counter first: if you just used Sophistry, he Sets a Trap; if you just Rebutted, he Reinforces. Against this kind of opponent, changing your move is the counter.

zh-TW: 偽裝預兆
en: Disguised Tells
note: trigger: 首次出現偽裝預兆（維多的尾聲）

zh-TW: 維多嘴上說「我認輸」，手卻把手套丟在桌上——那是他猛攻的動作。台詞與小動作對不上，就是「偽裝」：台詞會騙人，動作不會。以小動作為準。
en: Victor says "I concede" while tossing his glove on the table: that's the motion of his Onslaught. When the words and the gesture disagree, that's a "Disguise": words can lie, gestures can't. Go by the gesture.

zh-TW: 收尾：對手偵探
en: Finishing Up: Rival Detective
note: trigger: 維多的尾聲開始時

zh-TW: 維多不會就此認輸，他會亮出手上的底牌——通常是你漏掉的那件證物。讀懂他的動作，在他出手時用反駁截斷，出示 2 張以上能推翻底牌的實證，就能收尾。後面的對手偵探，手段會更狠。
en: Victor won't concede so easily; he'll reveal the card up his sleeve, usually the very piece of evidence you missed. Read his gestures, cut in with Rebut when he strikes, and present 2 or more pieces of solid evidence that overturn his hole card to finish it. Later rival detectives will play dirtier.

zh-TW: 逆・論破
en: Reverse Break
note: trigger: 首次出現逆・論破警告

zh-TW: 小心：對手偵探會反過來論破你。只要你出示的推理鏈裡有 3 條以上的詭辯，援護又已經用完，被他的陷阱抓到，就會被「逆・論破」。右下的狀態列會先亮紅警告你。
en: Beware: the rival detective can Break you right back. If the chain you present contains 3 or more Sophistry links, Cover has already been spent, and you are caught by his trap, you will be "Reverse Broken". The status bar at the lower right will flash red to warn you first.

zh-TW: 庇護者
en: Protector
note: trigger: 進入 Ch.5 論戰，顯示對手類型時

zh-TW: 這次的對手不是犯人，而是想保護某個人的「庇護者」。他大多在補強自己的說法、轉移焦點，硬碰硬的證據很難直接打中他。
en: This opponent isn't a culprit but a "Protector" who wants to shield someone. He mostly Reinforces his story and shifts the focus, so hard evidence has trouble hitting him head-on.

zh-TW: 觀察
en: Observe
note: trigger: 首次出現補強預兆後，選行動時（引導） | guided (locks other input)

zh-TW: 不確定該怎麼出手時，可以「觀察」：這回合不出牌，讓他繼續說下去。他開口時，你只受一半的傷，下一回合的預兆也會變成明示；他補強時，你會逼出一個說溜嘴的主張。
en: When you're unsure how to strike, you can "Observe": play no card this round and let him keep talking. If he speaks up, you take only half the damage and the next Tell becomes Clear; if he Reinforces, you force out a claim he let slip.

zh-TW: 失言
en: Slip of the Tongue
note: trigger: 首次觀察到補強

zh-TW: 說得越多，越容易說溜嘴。他補強時被你看出了破綻，多了一個「脆弱」的主張：任何攻擊打中它都能粉碎它，還會多造成 10 點傷害。
en: The more he says, the easier it is to let something slip. When he Reinforced, you spotted the flaw, so he gains a "Fragile" claim: any attack that hits it will smash it and deal 10 extra damage.

zh-TW: 補強回復
en: Reinforce Recovery
note: trigger: 首次有補強沒被打中

zh-TW: 他的補強沒有被打中，主導權回復了一成。對付愛補強的對手，與其一直防守，不如在他補強時用詭辯打穿，或先觀察，逼他說溜嘴。
en: His Reinforce wasn't hit, so his Dominance recovered by ten per cent. Against opponents who love to Reinforce, rather than just defending, punch through with Sophistry as they Reinforce, or Observe first to force a slip.

zh-TW: 醜聞證物
en: Scandal Evidence
note: trigger: 首次取得醜聞類證物時

zh-TW: 帶口紅印標籤的是醜聞類證物。用實證連鎖出示它、戳中與人物有關的主張，對手就會動搖，不管他還剩多少主導權。
en: Evidence with a lipstick-mark Tag is Scandal evidence. Present it in a Solid Chain and hit a claim tied to a person, and the opponent becomes Shaken, no matter how much Dominance he has left.

zh-TW: 破防線
en: The Breaking Line
note: trigger: Ch.5 首次嘗試 4 張連鎖卻沒動搖

zh-TW: 從這一章起，對手比較沉得住氣：4 張以上的實證連鎖，要等對手主導權降到六成以下，才能讓他動搖。醜聞類證物、黃金線索與截斷猛攻不受這個限制。
en: From this chapter on, opponents hold their nerve better: a Solid Chain of 4 or more cards can only leave them Shaken once their Dominance drops below sixty per cent. Scandal evidence, Golden Clues and cutting in on an Onslaught are exempt from this limit.

zh-TW: 第二套說詞
en: A Second Story
note: trigger: 首次進入中期尾聲

zh-TW: 中期以後的對手被論破後，會換一套說詞，例如從「我沒做」改成「我是為了保護某人」。尾聲時，要針對紫框的新說詞出手。中期以後，尾聲答錯會受到 60 點傷害。
en: From mid-game on, a Broken opponent switches to a second story, for example from "I didn't do it" to "I did it to protect someone". In the Endgame, aim at the new, purple-framed story. From mid-game on, a wrong answer in the Endgame costs you 60 damage.

zh-TW: 收尾：庇護者
en: Finishing Up: Protector
note: trigger: 庇護者尾聲開始時

zh-TW: 庇護者被揭穿後會打出悲情牌：「揭穿真相只會毀了一切，你承擔得起嗎？」這是一種補強，所以要出手攻擊，但一般物證說不動他。用實證連鎖出示帶有心形鎖的動機類證物，證明隱瞞才會帶來更大的災難。
en: Once exposed, the Protector plays the sympathy card: "Exposing the truth will only ruin everything. Can you bear that?" That is a kind of Reinforce, so strike back. But ordinary physical evidence won't move him. Present a Solid Chain with Motive evidence bearing a heart lock, to prove that hiding the truth will bring a greater disaster.

zh-TW: 劇情證物
en: Story Evidence
note: trigger: 首次取得劇情證物

zh-TW: 這件東西不能拿上論戰，但它記住了一段關係。日後在某些對話裡，它會打開一個新的選項。劇情證物收在證物冊的「私人收藏」。
en: This item can't be taken into a Debate, but it remembers a relationship. In some conversations later, it will open up a new option. Story Evidence is kept in the Evidence Book under "Private Collection".

zh-TW: 沒有警方支援
en: No Police Support
note: trigger: 進入約克郡第一個場景

zh-TW: 這裡離倫敦很遠，沒有警督替你開門，也沒有驗屍報告。遺體與機械都要交給亞瑟鑑定；進不去的地方，要靠自己爭取。
en: It's a long way from London, with no Inspector to open doors and no post-mortem reports. Bodies and machinery must be handed to Arthur to appraise; where you can't get in, you'll have to talk your way in.

zh-TW: 交涉
en: Negotiation
note: trigger: 首次遇到看守人物（引導） | guided (locks other input)

zh-TW: 看守的人不會因為你是偵探就放行。從證物冊選一件能說服他的證物出示。選對了就能進去；選錯了會白白花掉一格刻度。同一個人最多試三次。
en: Guards won't let you through just because you're a detective. Choose a piece of evidence from your Evidence Book that could persuade him, and present it. Choose right and you get in; choose wrong and a Tick is wasted. You can try the same person at most three times.

zh-TW: 潛入
en: Sneaking In
note: trigger: 首次遇到紅色封條，或交涉三次失敗

zh-TW: 紅色封條的區域只能潛入。潛入要花兩格刻度，而且有些地方再怎麼樣都潛不進去。
en: Areas with red tape can only be entered by sneaking. Sneaking costs two Ticks, and some places can't be sneaked into no matter what.

zh-TW: 沒有熱身
en: No Warm-up
note: trigger: Ch.6 第一次權限爭取

zh-TW: 外地章沒有警督可以糾正，也就沒有熱身小論戰。蒐證時爭取到的權限越多，論戰時手上的牌就越多。
en: In chapters away from London, there is no Inspector to correct, and so no Warm-up Debate. The more access you win during the Evidence Search, the more cards you'll hold in the Debate.

zh-TW: 中期論破
en: Mid-Game Break
note: trigger: Ch.6 論戰開始

zh-TW: 從這裡起，論破的條件更嚴：對手動搖時，要出示 2 到 3 張沒有弱點的連鎖；或先用觀察逼出脆弱的主張，再用 2 張以上的實證打中它。論破會削去對手 75% 的主導權。
en: From here on, the conditions for a Break are stricter: when the opponent is Shaken, present a chain of 2 to 3 cards with no Weak Points; or first use Observe to force out a Fragile claim, then hit it with 2 or more pieces of solid evidence. A Break strips seventy-five per cent of the opponent's Dominance.

zh-TW: 讀不透的對手
en: Hard-to-Read Opponents
note: trigger: Ch.6 第一個模糊預兆

zh-TW: 從這裡起，對手大多只露出模糊的預兆。先看兩個候選是不是同一類；再看有沒有星號，想想上一回合發生了什麼：他剛丟了主張？你剛出了詭辯？他的習慣都在對手筆記裡。
en: From here on, opponents mostly give only Vague Tells. First check whether the two candidates are the same type; then look for a star, and think about what happened last round: did he just lose a claim? Did you just use Sophistry? His habits are all in the Opponent Notes.

zh-TW: 第三次一定換招
en: Third Time, He Changes
note: trigger: 首次連續兩回合出現同一個行動

zh-TW: 對手已經連續兩回合出同一招了。第三回合，他一定會換招——那一招可以從候選裡刪掉。
en: The opponent has made the same move two rounds in a row. On the third round, he will definitely change his move: you can strike that move off the candidate list.

zh-TW: 兩邊都不虧
en: Cover Both Sides
note: trigger: 模糊預兆中兩個候選一攻一守、且沒有星號時

zh-TW: 一攻一守又沒有線索時，找一招兩邊都不會大虧的：對手可能補強也可能主張，就用觀察：他開口，你只受一半傷、還看清下一手；他補強，你逼出一個脆弱的主張；可能設陷也可能主張，實證連鎖不怕陷阱。
en: When the two candidates are one attack and one defence with no star to go on, look for the move that doesn't lose badly against either. If he might Reinforce or Assert, Observe: if he speaks up, you take half damage and see his next move; if he Reinforces, you force out a Fragile claim. If he might Set a Trap or Assert, a Solid Chain doesn't fear traps.

zh-TW: 兩位對手
en: Two Opponents
note: trigger: 論戰開始

zh-TW: 這場論戰分成兩段。第一段的對手是伯爵夫人（庇護者）；把她打完，第二段由維多・克勞接手，換成對手偵探的打法。你的主導權會延續到第二段，不會回復；亞瑟的援護每段各有一次，狐耳直覺則是整場共用。
en: This Debate comes in two parts. In the first, your opponent is the Countess (a Protector); once you've beaten her, Victor Crowe takes over, with a Rival Detective's style. Your Dominance carries over to the second part and is not restored; Arthur's Cover is available once per part, but Fox-Ear Instinct is shared across the whole debate.

zh-TW: 場外證物
en: Offstage Evidence
note: trigger: 首次出現「？」主張

zh-TW: 寫著「？」的主張，背後是你拿不到的家族證物。它還不能被選為目標。觀察能逼對手把它說出來；說出來之後，它就變成一般的主張。
en: A claim marked "?" is backed by family evidence you can't get hold of. It can't be targeted yet. Observe can force the opponent to say it out loud; once said, it becomes an ordinary claim.

zh-TW: 換人了
en: A Change of Opponent
note: trigger: 第二段開始

zh-TW: 維多接手了。對手筆記換到他的那一頁：你在 Ch.4 學到的小動作都還在。他會偽裝預兆，看到沒有「依據」銅牌的明示時，先看他的手。
en: Victor has taken over. The Opponent Notes have turned to his page: the gestures you learned in Chapter 4 are all still there. He will Disguise his Tells; when you see a Clear Tell without the "Basis" brass tag, watch his hands first.

zh-TW: 將計就計
en: Turning the Tables
note: trigger: 維多的尾聲開始時

zh-TW: 維多承認剛才被你打碎的推理只是誘餌，接著亮出了真正的底牌。這一手會以偽裝的預兆出現：讀懂他的動作，在他出手時用反駁截斷，出示「鏈外事實」——也就是黃金線索——或專門推翻那張底牌的證物。打中了，就是「二連論破」，直接獲勝。
en: Victor admits the reasoning you just smashed was only bait, then reveals his real hole card. This move comes with a Disguised Tell: read his gestures, cut in with Rebut as he strikes, and present an "Outside Fact" (that is, a Golden Clue) or evidence made specifically to overturn that hole card. If it lands, it's a "Double Break", and you win outright.

zh-TW: 絕境重組
en: Last-Ditch Rebuild
note: trigger: 首次被逆・論破（不限章節）

zh-TW: 你的推理鏈全斷了，主導權只剩最後一點。但對手為了論破你，亮出了他藏得最深的證物——現在它也在你的線索板上了。你有一次重新拉線的機會：用它組出符合本章論破條件的鏈，就能「反擊論破」。
en: Your Reasoning Chains have all been severed and only the last sliver of Dominance remains. But in order to Break you, the opponent has played the most deeply hidden evidence he had, and now it's on your Clue Board too. You get one chance to redraw your links: assemble a chain that meets this chapter's Break conditions using it, and you can land a "Counter Break".

zh-TW: 學成
en: Graduation
note: trigger: Ch.7 結算

zh-TW: 你已經學會了所有論戰手法。接下來的對手，會把它們全部混在一起用。
en: You've now learned every debating technique. The opponents to come will use them all, mixed together.

zh-TW: 熟悉的陌生城市
en: A Familiar, Unfamiliar City
note: trigger: 進入比對模式

zh-TW: 左邊是你記憶中的樣子，右邊是現在。找出五處變了的地方。點錯了不會怎樣，點錯幾次之後，亞瑟會開始提示你。
en: On the left is the city as you remember it; on the right, as it is now. Find the five things that have changed. A wrong click costs nothing, but after a few wrong clicks, Arthur will start giving you hints.

zh-TW: 殘缺的證物
en: Damaged Evidence
note: trigger: 首次取得次級替代證物

zh-TW: 卡框破損的證物，是用來替代你沒拿到的線索。它能幫你撐過這一戰，但用它拉的線一定是虛線，也不能當成鏈外事實。
en: Evidence with a broken card frame stands in for a clue you didn't get. It can help you survive this fight, but any link you draw with it is always a dashed line, and it can't count as an Outside Fact.

zh-TW: 三副面孔
en: Three Faces
note: trigger: 9-4 論戰開始

zh-TW: 這位對手會隨著主導權下降換三種打法：先是犯人，再是庇護者，最後是詭辯家。對手類型圖示會跟著換，對手筆記也會翻到對應的那一頁。只有最後一種打法時，才能論破他。
en: This opponent changes through three styles as their Dominance falls: first a Culprit, then a Protector, finally a Sophist. The opponent type icon changes with them, and the Opponent Notes turn to the matching page. You can only Break them in their final style.

zh-TW: 輿論風向標
en: The Weathervane of Public Opinion
note: trigger: Ch.10 論戰開始

zh-TW: 這是公開辯論，群眾也在聽。對手動搖時，沒有弱點的實證連鎖威力會變成三倍；含詭辯的鏈則照舊。但在群眾面前被陷阱抓到詭辯，會一口氣失去一半的主導權。
en: This is a public debate, and the crowd is listening. When the opponent is Shaken, a Solid Chain with no Weak Points deals triple damage; chains containing Sophistry stay as they are. But if a Sophistry is caught in a trap in front of the crowd, you lose half your Dominance at a stroke.

zh-TW: 後期論破
en: Late-Game Break
note: trigger: Ch.10 論戰開始（第二則）

zh-TW: 最後的對手更沉得住氣：4 張以上的實證連鎖要等對手主導權降到一半以下才能讓他動搖。論破需要 3 到 4 張以上的連鎖，而且其中必須有黃金線索。後期的尾聲答錯，會受到 80 點傷害。
en: The final opponents hold their nerve better still: a Solid Chain of 4 or more cards can leave them Shaken only once their Dominance falls to half or below. A Break needs a chain of 3 to 4 or more cards, and it must include a Golden Clue. A wrong answer in the late-game Endgame costs you 80 damage.

zh-TW: 堅固的主張
en: Sturdy Claims
note: trigger: 首次出現堅固節點

zh-TW: 黑鐵框的主張是對手最核心的說法。實證連鎖照樣打得碎它；但要在他開口時截斷它，反駁就得用黃金線索——一般證物的反駁擋得住這一下、也能反擊，主張卻會留在場上。
en: A claim in a black-iron frame is the core of the opponent's story. A Solid Chain can still smash it; but to cut in on it as he speaks, your Rebut must use a Golden Clue. A Rebut with Common Evidence will block the hit and counter, but the claim stays on the table.

zh-TW: 社交禮儀
en: Social Etiquette
note: trigger: Ch.11 首次社交對話

zh-TW: 宴會上，問話也要講究禮節。右上的扇子是你的禮儀：應對失禮會少一格，三格用完，貴族們就不會再跟你說話了。
en: At a banquet, even questions need manners. The fan at the upper right is your etiquette: each breach of manners costs one segment, and when all three are gone, the nobles will no longer speak to you.

zh-TW: 多階段論戰
en: Multi-Stage Debate
note: trigger: 首次多階段論戰

zh-TW: 這場論戰分成幾個階段，中間不會回到線索板，對手的主導權也不會重置。援護與狐耳直覺都是整場共用，省著點用。
en: This Debate is split into several stages, with no return to the Clue Board in between, and the opponent's Dominance is not reset. Cover and Fox-Ear Instinct are shared across the whole debate, so use them sparingly.

zh-TW: 以退為進
en: Retreat to Advance
note: trigger: Ch.12 論戰開始

zh-TW: Wolfhart 會故意示弱或示強，她的預兆有很多是偽裝。她的台詞不可信，但她的手不會說謊：敲指節是設陷、輕晃酒杯是補強、冷笑是主張；放下酒杯再冷笑，就是猛攻。
en: Wolfhart will deliberately show weakness or strength; many of her Tells are Disguised. Her words can't be trusted, but her hands don't lie: rapping her knuckles is Set a Trap, a gentle swirl of the wine glass is Reinforce, a cold smile is Assert; set the glass down and then smile coldly, and it's an Onslaught.

zh-TW: 看穿
en: Seen Through
note: trigger: 首次讀出 Wolfhart 的偽裝並讀對

zh-TW: 你看穿了她。對她來說，台詞和動作對不上的那一刻，就是她露出的破綻。狐耳直覺也能直接看穿偽裝，但只有兩次。
en: You've seen through her. For her, the moment her words and gestures disagree is the moment she shows a weakness. Fox-Ear Instinct can also see through a disguise directly, but you only have two.

zh-TW: 完全自洽之壁
en: The Wall of Perfect Consistency
note: trigger: 首次無法讓 Wolfhart 動搖

zh-TW: 一般的證物動搖不了她。只有兩種方法：用含黃金線索的反駁截斷她的猛攻；或在她剩一半以下時，用含黃金線索的 4 張以上實證連鎖打中她。
en: Ordinary evidence can't leave her Shaken. There are only two ways: cut in on her Onslaught with a Rebut that includes a Golden Clue; or, once she is at half Dominance or below, hit her with a Solid Chain of 4 or more cards that includes a Golden Clue.

zh-TW: 命運的回合
en: Round of Fate
note: trigger: 第一個劇本回合

zh-TW: 有些回合的結果早已寫好，不管你出什麼都改變不了。預兆區的眼睛會換成一枚鎖上的齒輪。撐過去，下一回合才是你的。
en: The outcome of some rounds has already been written, and nothing you play can change it. The eye in the Tell area is replaced by a locked gear. Survive it, and the next round is yours.
